svg.title: Side quest: anime runner mini-game
svg.desc: An original chibi hacker girl with a silver-blue bob, round glasses, a yellow raincoat and a laptop runs through a Tokyo night city, jumps over a bug and a 404 block, and cheers as she collects a paper and a trophy while the score climbs from 2024 to 2026.
